author: Slidebean
description:
The U.S. town where Wi-Fi is banned

In West Virginia, microwaves and Wi-Fi can get you fined.

You’re inside the National Radio Quiet Zone, home to the ultra sensitive Green Bank Telescope.

It listens to the universe.
So it needs radio silence.

The problem?
Modern tech has flooded the spectrum.

The quiet zone isn’t so quiet anymore.

👉 Would you live somewhere without Wi-Fi for the sake of science?
title: The place in America where Wi-Fi is illegal
